gloss: to starve; to go hungry; to hunger for

definitions.gloss: to starve; to go hungry; to be famished
definitions.explanation: To suffer from a lack of food. Describes a state of serious hunger or starvation, not merely being peckish.

definitions.gloss: to hunger for; to crave; to thirst for
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to strongly desire or crave something that is lacking, such as love, knowledge, stimulation, or recognition.

notes:
USAGE:
{飢|う}える is an ichidan verb. The literal meaning (sense 1) describes serious hunger or starvation. The figurative meaning (sense 2) is very common and follows the pattern 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飢|う}える (to hunger for ~).

The kanji can also be written as {餓|う}える, though {飢|う}える is more standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{飢|う}え→飢え：19826_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧ (to suffer from hunger)
- ⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飢|う}える (to hunger for affection)
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飢|う}える (to thirst for knowledge)
- {飢|う}えた⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (hungry eyes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飢|う}える: to starve (severe hunger; also figurative craving)
- ⟦{空腹|くうふく}→空腹：06532_kuufuku⟧: hunger (the state of having an empty stomach)
- ⟦{餓死|がし}→餓死：17156_gashi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to die of starvation (fatal outcome)
- ⟦{渇望|かつぼう}→渇望：05999_katsubou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to yearn for (formal, figurative only)
